title: Historical Audit Engine
objective: Build a read-only, complexity-aware historical audit engine that maps requirements, code, tests and evidence in bounded batches, records findings separately, and never rewrites certified historical evidence.

tasks.description: Define complexity-aware historical audit batching and qualification.
Define the historical audit manifest and read-only batch lifecycle.
Map historical requirements to implementation tests contracts and evidence.
Implement the historical audit findings registry.
Define isolated remediation workflow separate from historical evidence.
Re-qualify immutable historical evidence protection under the audit engine.

done_when: historical lots are partitioned into deterministic bounded batches from declared complexity signals
historical audit execution remains read-only until a separate remediation transition
requirements code tests contracts and evidence can be mapped without rewriting historical artifacts
findings are recorded separately with severity ownership and disposition
remediation cannot mutate frozen evidence or silently change historical certification facts
audit engine remains zero-cost and context-bounded
